textRuns.value: 1) Tornado is a bar chart with category values listed vertically. Use for comparing the relative importance of a variable between two distinct groups.
2) Group and Values fields are required.
3) Each distinct Group value is a separate bar containing left and right parts.
4) If provided, Legend field should contain only 2 distinct values. First of them will be used for left bars, second - for the right bars.
5) Another approach is to provide two fields into Values fuld bucket.
6) X axis option allows to specify max value for each Legend - so bars can be scaled differently for the left and right parts
7) Data and Group labels, Legend can be customized using formatting pane.
